artworks.title: Thomas Osborne, First Duke of Leeds
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring an upper-body portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man's body is forward-facing with a slight angle, showing a partial three-quarters view of his face. His facial features include a distinct nose and a slightly solemn expression. He has long, curly hair flowing over his shoulders and wears a high-collared garment with patterned details. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of straight, vertical lines contrasting with the busy texture of the hair. Below the portrait is a plaque with the man's name and title, "Thomas Osborne, Earl of Danby, Lord High Treasurer of England," along with artist and engraver credits. The overall presentation suggests a formal style typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Edward Montagu, First Earl of Sandwich
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed black-and-white engraving of a man's upper body. He is facing forward, with distinct facial features including full lips and a serene expression. The man has long, curly hair flowing over his shoulders and is wearing ornate armor, a lace cravat, and an embellished brooch. The engraving is enclosed in an oval frame adorned with laurel leaves and decorative elements. Below the man, an emblem features a hand holding scales emerging from clouds, with the Latin text "ensis Potior Sceptro." The background consists of an etched pattern.

artworks.title: Edward Montagu, Second Earl of Sandwich
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man with curly hair. He is looking directly at the viewer, wearing an elaborate period outfit. His hands are placed elegantly. The background has textured shading typical of engravings from that era. An inscription identifies the person in the portrait.

artworks.title: Frans Rubens
artworks.artist: Studio of Sir Peter Paul Rubens after Abraham Blooteling
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a young person in profile view facing left. The individual has a round face with large eyes and a small mouth. They have wavy hair styled with curls framing the face, and wear a garment resembling a cloak or drapery. The person also wears a decorative headpiece with lace or fabric detailing. The portrait is rendered in a monochrome style, possibly an engraving or etching, with detailed shading providing depth to the features and clothing. The background is plain to emphasize the figure and headwear.

artworks.title: George Alsop
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etched portrait of a person. The subject is facing the viewer with a slightly tilted head. The facial features are sharp and defined, with a neutral expression. The person has long, wavy hair and is wearing a garment with a high, decorative collar. They appear to be within an ornate oval frame with intricate designs. Below the frame is an inscription in script, and a small coat of arms is visible at the bottom center. The background has concentric lines creating depth behind the figure.

artworks.title: George Alsop
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of an individual within an oval frame. The person has a long oval face, prominent eyes, long curly hair falling to the shoulders, a cap or headpiece, draped clothing with fine fabric folds, and a pleated collar. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is textured and dark, contrasting with the lighter figure. Text and a coat of arms, and labels "Bible" and "To Prayer Book," are at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Edward Hatton, Arithmetician
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in a bust-length portrait framed in an oval border. The man faces the viewer, with long, curly hair reaching his shoulders. He has distinct facial features including an upturned mouth, wide nose, and pronounced cheeks. He wears a formal coat with a high collar and a cravat. The background is a dark, textured surface. The oval is surrounded by decorative ribbons and set against a backdrop resembling a carved stone pedestal with initials or a name at the base.

artworks.title: John Heydon, Astrologer and Rosicrucian
artworks.description: A portrait of a man is shown within an oval frame. The man is depicted from the chest upwards, facing forward with a slight turn to the left. He has distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, and long, curly hair flowing past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark garment with an elaborately embroidered collar. The background features symbols and a shield with a coat of arms below the portrait, as well as an inscription along the edge of the oval. The image is monochromatic with intricate lines and shading, reminiscent of an engraving.

artworks.title: William Ramsay, Physician and Astrologer
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with their head resting on their right hand, which is supported by a bent elbow on a surface or table. The person has long, wavy hair that extends past the shoulders and is wearing a garment with voluminous sleeves, each adorned with a ruffle at the cuff. The person is positioned slightly sideways toward a table that has a rectangular cloth draped over it. On the table, there is an open book and a nearby inkwell with a quill. The background of the image is a textured pattern.

artworks.title: William Ramsay, Physician and Astrologer
artworks.description: The image shows an upper torso view of a person. The individual is seated and appears to be leaning on a table or similar surface with their right elbow, resting their head on their right hand. They have long, curly hair cascading around their shoulders. The person has a slightly downward gaze, with defined facial features including arched eyebrows and a straight nose. The clothing is ornate, featuring a richly patterned garment with voluminous, ruffled cuffs at the sleeves. Two books are visible to the right of the person; one is open, and the other has a visible spine and title that reads "THE CHARACTER OF TRUE NOBILITY AND GENTILITY". The background consists of intricately patterned textures that complement the intricate details of the person's attire.

artworks.title: William Sermon, M.D.
artworks.description: The image displays a man's upper body in an oval frame. The man is facing slightly to the side but looking directly at the viewer. He has a composed expression with distinctive facial features, including a slightly prominent nose and full lips. His long, thick, curly hair falls to his shoulders. He wears a formal garment with a decorative lace collar and patterned fabric. A woven or textured cloth drapes around his shoulders. The portrait is detailed in black and white, with fine lines for shading and texture. The man is surrounded by a Latin inscription within the oval frame, and the background has parallel lines.

artworks.title: Robert Bruce, First Earl of Arlesbury
artworks.artist: Robert White after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, looking at the viewer. He has distinct features, including a long nose and curly hair. He is dressed in elaborate attire, holding a crown-like object in his right hand. The background includes trees, adding to the formal atmosphere.

artworks.title: Anne Boleyn
artworks.description: This image displays an engraved portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is shown in a three-quarter view facing left. The woman has delicate facial features, high cheekbones, and a composed expression. She wears an intricate headdress, a decorated hood or bonnet with a veil. She also wears a richly designed bodice with a high neckline and ornate patterns denoting high status. Around her neck, there is a pearl necklace with a small pendant. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with faint surrounding text. The background is plain, focusing on the figure, and there is text at the bottom of the engraving for context.

artworks.title: John Aylmer, D.D., Bishop of London, Preceptor to Lady Jane Grey
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a male figure from the chest up. The man has a long, pointed beard and a serious expression. He is depicted with a wide-brimmed cap and a layered garment. In the background, there is an oval frame with a circular crest or emblem at the bottom center. The engraving is set against a textured backdrop, with a formal presentation.

artworks.title: Henry Somerset, Earl of Worcester, First Dukeof Beaufort
artworks.artist: Robert White after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The man in the artwork is depicted from the waist up, seated in an upright position. He has well-defined facial features with a long face, slender nose, and slightly parted lips. His hair is long, voluminous, and curly, extending to his shoulders. The clothing is elaborate and aristocratic, with a large, lace-trimmed collar and a detailed, layered garment with various textures and designs. He wears a sash and a chain of office with rosettes and an ornamental medallion. Drapery, bows, and a visible sword handle are also present. The background is textured and dark with faint architectural elements like columns. Printed text and a coat of arms are seen below the figure.

artworks.title: Henry Somerset, First Duke of Beaufort
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person seated in a stately pose. The individual has long, curly hair, neutral facial expression with arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. They wear an elaborate outfit with a wide lace collar, ruffles, and bows on the sleeves. The person wears a chain of office and a sword. They rest their right arm on a surface, holding feathers with their left hand. The background shows large architectural elements. Below the image is an inscription with heraldic symbols and text detailing titles or identity.

artworks.title: Dr. John Blow, Musical Composer and Organist
artworks.description: This is a black and white portrait etching of Dr. John Blow, depicting his upper body and head. The person is shown in a three-quarter view facing the right side of the image. He has a full, rounded face, with a slight smile, and his eyes look directly ahead. His hair is long, curly, and voluminous, cascading down past his shoulders. Dr. Blow is dressed in formal attire typical of the late 17th to early 18th century, with a visible white collared garment underneath a dark robe or cloak. There is no visible jewelry, but the design around him is ornate, resembling an embellished oval frame with intricate scrollwork and a heraldic coat of arms below. The background consists of fine lines that provide a textured backdrop within the oval frame, and outside of it, the area is less detailed, with plain paper. The name "Dr. John Blow" is inscribed below the portrait on the lower margin of the page.

artworks.title: Dr. John Browne, Surgeon
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the chest up. He is positioned facing slightly to the right with his head turned toward the viewer. He has long, curly hair that reaches his shoulders and frames his face. His facial features include a strong jawline, a straight nose, and direct gaze. He is wearing an elaborately patterned necktie and a garment typical of the late-17th century, with visible layers and intricate designs. The scene is framed within an ornate border with scrollwork and cherubic figures. The background is dark, highlighting the details of the man's attire and the frame. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man.

artworks.title: Dr. John Browne, Surgeon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait focusing on the upper half of the person's body. A male figure is depicted in an elegant and formal pose, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. His facial features include a prominent nose and closed lips, with a neutral expression. The figure has long, voluminous curly hair falling over his shoulders. He is dressed in ornate 17th-century attire, with a lace cravat visible beneath an embroidered or patterned robe or coat. The figure is framed by an elaborately decorated oval cartouche with decorative scrollwork and cherublike faces at the top and sides. The background is filled with intricate patterns typical of engravings from this era. The text at the bottom identifies the person in the portrait as “Johannes Browne, Regis Britannia, nec-non Nosocomii sui Chirurgus Ordinarius,” and credits the engraving to 'R. White Sculp.'

artworks.title: Dr. John Browne
artworks.artist: Robert White after Henry Robert Morland
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait of a man in period clothing sitting. He is facing slightly to the side, showing a three-quarter view. The man has a prominent nose, slightly arched eyebrows, and curly hair flowing over his shoulders. He wears a high-collared coat with a cravat or lace around his neck. Surrounding him is an oval frame with radiating lines. In the background, there is a dark stippled texture. Below the portrait, a script identifies the man as "Joannis Browne" and provides additional information about the engraver and artist.

artworks.title: John Browne
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man, framed within an oval. The man has a long face, prominent nose, large eyes, and long, curly hair. He is wearing a formal outfit with a lace cravat and a velvet-like coat. Surrounding the oval frame is a decorative border with ribbons, scrollwork, and a coat of arms at the bottom center. The background has intricate line work. Below the portrait is the name, Joannis Browne, along with his title and the date 1681.

artworks.title: William Camden
artworks.description: The image is an illustrated portrait of a middle-aged man. He is seated and facing the viewer with a slight turn to his left. He has a short beard and mustache, and his hair is combed back, revealing a high hairline. He wears a large ruffled collar and a buttoned garment with design details on the shoulders. The background features an oval frame with decorative elements, including coats of arms and inscriptions.

artworks.title: William Camden
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a man's upper body. The man is in a seated position, facing slightly to his right. He has a middle-aged or older facial appearance with a beard and mustache. His hair is short and covered with a cap. The man is wearing a textured jacket or doublet with buttons and a large ruff collar around his neck. There are no identifiable objects in his hands. The background is plain with a textured pattern within an oval border. Symbols above the border include a shield with crosses in a circle on the left and a triangle with stars on the right. At the bottom, there is Latin text "GULIELMUS CAMDENUS CLARENTIUS ÆTATIS LVIII. M.DC.IX."

artworks.title: William Camden
artworks.description: This engraving features a portrait of a man's upper body. He faces slightly to the right, with his head turned toward the viewer, displaying a composed expression. The man has a short, neatly trimmed beard and wears a small cap. He is dressed in a formal garment with a ruffled collar, buttons down his chest, and an ornate frame surrounding the portrait. Below the frame, there is a decorative area with a skull and crossbones on the right side. The background is detailed, showing a reclining figure holding an hourglass and a scythe above the portrait, along with a heraldic symbol. Text is present on the frame and base of the engraving.
